next_step: Finalize EU Dedicated pricing; security review with infra (2025-12-10)
notes: Initial intro call 2025-11-12 — AE Sofia, PM Marta, infra lead Jonas. Interested in quick hosted test before committing to Dedicated.
Key ask: EU data residency + ability to pin processing to eu-west and eu-central; procurement: 'We cannot have primary processing outside EU.'
POC scope agreed 2025-11-18: 3-week POC, chat assistant on product support, embeddings for doc search, reranking for search results. Baseline: existing OpenAI usage ~30k tokens/day.
Technical constraints: strict retention controls (30 days), KMS integration required, SSO via SAML (Okta), SOC2/audit logs required for procurement signoff.
Latency targets: p75/p95 <120ms for chat inside DE region; cross-region fallback OK up to 200ms. Concern: multi-region routing to reduce cold-starts vs data residency guarantees.
AE note: demo of Hosted API showed 150-220ms in eu-central — acceptable for early phase. SE recommends Dedicated for consistent p95 under 110ms and to handle throughput spikes.
Pricing: procurement asks for committed volume discount and overage caps. Preliminary ARR target 75k-150k. Waiting on EU Dedicated pricing deck (linked).
Security review: questionnaire sent 2025-11-20. Need SOC2 evidence + KMS integration diagram. SE to provide key rotation/WRAP flow for legal.
Ops ask: multi-AZ HA in eu-west + eu-central and clear fallback routing policy. Concern about added latency when routing to alternate EU region for capacity.
Next steps: SE Liam to run hosted vs Dedicated latency comparison (eu-central hosted vs dedicated in eu-west colo), deliver numbers by 2025-12-04. Schedule security deep-dive 2025-12-10.
Quotes/feedback: 'We need predictable p95s for customer-facing chat — jitter kills UX' (Jonas, infra).
Follow-ups: Legal wants explicit 'no egress to US' clause in SOW; Finance needs final pricing by 2025-12-20 for Q1 budget cycle.
